description: This file defines a Gradle plugin class 'AndroidApplicationJacocoConventionPlugin' that applies Jacoco code coverage settings to an Android application project. It imports necessary Android and Gradle APIs, and contains plugin application and configuration logic.

classes.name: AndroidApplicationJacocoConventionPlugin
classes.description: A Gradle plugin class that applies the Jacoco plugin and configures code coverage for Android applications.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the plugin logic to a given Gradle project, including applying the Jacoco plugin and configuring Jacoco settings.
